title: Commentary: Rogue Chinese AI really wants to go to the zoo. That’s a problem
paragraphs: Commentary: Rogue Chinese AI really wants to go to the zoo. That’s a problem
AI firms need to invest more in discovering, tracking and - most importantly - disclosing what their agents are up to, says Catherine Thorbecke for Bloomberg Opinion.

TOKYO: I wrote before that it was only a matter of time before we saw incidents of “rogue” behaviour from Chinese AI agents. Now, we’re starting to see what that looks like. So far, they just really want to find the best way into the zoo.
